title: Ken Jennings details Jeopardy! achievement he wants to reach as host - NewsBreak
text:
By Demetria Osei-Tutu ,
37 minutes ago Ken Jennings is sharing a Jeopardy! dream that he wants to achieve in the future
The Jeopardy! host took to his Instagram on Friday, August 29 to share with fans that he wants to use the backstage label maker and hopes that he'll have the opportunity when he reaches a certain number of years at the ABC trivia game show. Ken posted a photo of the label maker, and it printing out the label, "Jeopardy! Wardrobe."
He captioned the post, "Really hoping to host Jeopardy! long enough that they let me play with the backstage label maker." Ken has been hosting Jeopardy! since January 2021, following the death of Alex Trebek in November 2020.
READ MORE: Jeopardy! host Ken Jennings flaunts his 'tie-bible' as he gives 'tour' of on-air wardrobe
READ MORE: NBC forced to cut cameras as couple caught in explicit act during live broadcast
Before Ken became the official solo host in December 2023, he was co-hosting with actress Mayim Bialik.
The 51-year-old has a history with Jeopardy! and it started when he was a contestant in 2004. But Ken was more than a contestant as he secured the title of a Jeopardy! champion who has broken records.
According to the Leaderboard of Legends , he is ranked number one with the most consecutive games won with 74 and has the highest winnings (regular-season play) with $2,520,700.
He also went on to participate in different Jeopardy! tournaments and specials, such as one in 2011, where he faced off against Watson, the AI IBM computer, along with another notable Jeopardy! champion, Brad Rutter.
Ken also recently revealed on his Instagram how many ties make up his tie collection for Jeopardy! The joint post (with the official Jeopardy! Instagram) was shared on Tuesday, September. It included a video of the author giving fans a behind-the-scenes look into his wardrobe, specifically his ties.
Ken captioned the post, "This is Ken’s tie tour (Jeopardy!’s Version) #Jeopardy!" In the beginning of the video, Ken makes a reference to a famous catchphrase from the early 200s reality TV show, MTV Cribs: "I’m Ken Jennings, and this is my crib." He was dressed in a navy blue suit, a blue button-down, and a pinkish-purple patterned tie.
As he opens the door to the dressing room, he showcases his whole collection of ties which varied in color and patterns. He shouted out Steven Zimbelman, who was Alex's wardrobe guy, and works with Ken now.
Ken said that there are about 220 ties in the dressing room. He shared that he loves a floral tie and that he and Steve also love paisley. Ken also showed viewers the "Tie Bible," which has all the ties scanned in a binder so they can have a reference for them. He further disclosed that the show has tuberwares of Alex's era ties and they have codes for them, which they label with his initials (AT). Ken said it was very "special" to have those ties.
Jeopardy comes back for its 42nd season on September 8, 2025.
